name: Sleep-Deprived Strategist
subtitle: Plotting master plans at 3:42 AM
description: You solved world hunger in your head, but cannot remember if you brushed your teeth.
prescription: Drink water and close 37 browser tabs immediately.

name: Professional Overthinker
subtitle: Analyzing a 2-word email for 45 minutes
description: When someone replies "Sounds good.", you deduce they harbor a feudal vendetta.
prescription: Turn off notification previews and take 3 deep breaths.

name: Chaotic Neutral Intern
subtitle: Pressing buttons just to see what happens
description: Dropped production once, but brought donuts so everyone forgave you.
prescription: Revoke your own terminal write permissions.

name: Emotionally Offline
subtitle: Status: 404 Sentiment Not Found
description: A meteor could crash through the living room and you would murmur "Typical Tuesday".
prescription: Apply a hot beverage directly to your forehead.

name: CEO of Doing Nothing
subtitle: Master of active horizontal loafing
description: Looking busy while debating between cheese puffs and salt-and-vinegar chips.
prescription: Promote yourself to Senior Executive Couch Potato.

name: WiFi-Dependent Organism
subtitle: Dies when latency exceeds 80ms
description: Your nervous system is fiber optic. If the router blinks red, your heartbeat drops.
prescription: Look at a real cloud through a physical window.

name: Caffeine Anxiety Machine
subtitle: Vibrating at 240 beats per minute
description: Third espresso. You can hear colors and taste your incoming Slack notification.
prescription: Switch to chamomile before you ascend into orbit.

name: Tab Hoarder Deluxe
subtitle: 143 open tabs you swear you will read
description: Browser tabs are 2 pixels wide. Closing one feels like deleting your soul.
prescription: Press Ctrl+Shift+W and embrace sweet liberation.

name: Certified ASAP Dodger
subtitle: If it is urgent, it should have been planned earlier
description: Masters degree in looking intensely thoughtful whenever someone asks for an ETA.
prescription: Put Slack status as "Focusing" for the next 7 years.

name: Unbothered Potato
subtitle: Starch-based inner peace
description: Zero thoughts in that round head. Just vibes, butter, and rejection of hustle culture.
prescription: Stay wrapped in blanket foil until golden brown.

name: Existential Snack Seeker
subtitle: Opening the fridge for the 14th time
description: You are not hungry; you seek cosmic truth behind the jar of pickled jalapenos.
prescription: Accept that the fridge contents have not changed in 8 minutes.

name: Feral Spreadsheet Enthusiast
subtitle: VLOOKUP is my love language
description: Color-coding your grocery list with conditional formatting and nested logic.
prescription: Use an index-match and call it a day.

name: Draft Folder Philosopher
subtitle: Greatest speeches never sent
description: Writing scathing 800-word draft replies, then deleting all and writing "Sounds good!".
prescription: Write it in a notebook and close the book gently.

name: Chief Procrastination Architect
subtitle: Deep-cleaning baseboards before a deadline
description: Reorganizing spice racks alphabetically rather than writing a 2-page report.
prescription: Do the dreaded task for just 300 seconds.

name: Ghost Mode Specialist
subtitle: Read receipts turned off since 2017
description: Replying in your head, believing you sent it, wondering why friends send search parties.
prescription: Send a single thumbs-up emoji to maintain citizenship.

name: Accidental Overachiever
subtitle: Panicked effort disguised as genius
description: Not trying to be employee of the month; just terrified of having a 1-on-1 review.
prescription: Take credit for the win and go nap immediately.
